7 Common, 6 perspective Current Pane, 9 Modeling roots. Modeling root order comes from modelingMenuSet.menuArray.

divider=true plus dividerLabel is a non-clickable group heading, never a submenu. optionBox=true entries are distinct adjacent option actions; their auto-generated label may not be visible text.

children.label: Blend Shape
children.annotation: Create a new Blend Shape on an object/group that can blend between other deformations / the original mesh shape.

children.annotation: Creates a transform driven deformation for a set of points on an object (CVs, vertices, or lattice points).

children.label: Delta Mush
children.annotation: Filters deformation artifacts and creates smoothing effects.

children.label: ML Deformer
children.annotation: Approximate a deformation using machine learning.

children.label: Tension
children.annotation: Simulates surface tension using the connectivity between mesh vertices without squashing or stretching the geometry.

children.label: Solidify
children.annotation: Makes parts of the geometry more solid locally removing the deformation.

children.label: Lattice
children.annotation: Surrounds geometry with a flexible grid that you can use to change the object's shape.

children.label: Proximity Wrap
children.annotation: Lets you deform target geometry using other geometry as drivers. Once the deformer is created, set and connect drivers with the Manage Drivers menu in the Attribute Editor.

children.label: Wrap
children.annotation: Deform objects by modifying a mesh that surrounds them.

children.label: ShrinkWrap
children.annotation: Deform objects by wrapping them around another mesh.

children.label: Morph
children.annotation: Lets you deform geometry towards a morph target.

children.label: Wire
children.annotation: Deform objects by having their surfaces follow the shape of a curve.

children.label: Wrinkle
children.annotation: Combines the Cluster and Wire deformers to create wrinkle deformations.

children.label: Create Pose Interpolator

children.label: Bend
children.annotation: Bends geometry relative to a central handle.

children.label: Sine

children.label: Squash
children.annotation: Deforms a geometry by squashing and stretching along an axis.

children.label: Twist
children.annotation: Twists points on a surface around their center.

children.label: Wave
children.annotation: Deforms geometry along a circular sine wave.

children.annotation: Copy the current template brush settings onto the most recently created stroke

children.label: Get Settings from Selected Stroke
children.annotation: Copy the brush settings from the currently selected stroke to the template brush

children.label: Apply Settings to Selected Strokes
children.annotation: Copy the template brush settings to the currently selected strokes

children.label: Share One Brush
children.annotation: Cause selected strokes to share a common brush (so that editing the brush changes the appearance of all these strokes)

children.label: Remove Brush Sharing
children.annotation: Give each selected stroke a unique brush (if it was previously sharing a brush)

children.label: Select Brush/Stroke Names Containing...
children.annotation: Select brushes/strokes whose name contains the specified characters

children.label: Create Modifier
children.annotation: Create a line modifier object and attach to selected toon lines

children.label: Set Modifier Fill Object
children.annotation: This sets the selected mesh to be used for the occupy effect on the selected modifier.

children.label: Loop Brush Animation
children.annotation: Make the selected brush's animation loop seamlessly

children.label: Make Brush Spring
children.annotation: Add an expression simulating spring dynamics to the selected stroke(s)

children.label: Bake Spring Animation
children.annotation: Create animation curves for any selected stroke(s) which had "Make Brush Spring" applied

children.label: Simplify Stroke Path Curves
children.annotation: Reduce the number of CVs in the selected stroke(s)

children.label: Set Stroke Control Curves
children.annotation: Make selected curve(s) control the selected stroke(s) (see Curve Follow attribute)

children.label: Attach Brush to Curves
children.annotation: Create a new stroke using the selected curve(s) and the template brush

children.label: Transfer All Strokes to new Object
children.annotation: Select a source mesh or nurbs followed by a destination of the same type to transfer strokes onto.

children.label: Make Pressure Curve
children.annotation: Create a curve to adjust brushstroke pressure values

children.label: Paint Grid
children.annotation: Paint current brush onto selected surfaces using a grid layout

children.label: Paint Random
children.annotation: Paint current brush onto selected surfaces using a random layout

children.label: Mesh Quality Attributes
children.annotation: Edit mesh quality attributes for selected stroke or Paint Effects mesh

children.label: Preset Blending
children.annotation: Set mix-in levels for brush presets

children.label: Save Brush Preset...
children.annotation: Save the settings of the template brush to current shelf or Visor directory
